intervention: Native physics5ms/decimation4/explicitPD200Hz versus physics2.5ms/decimation8/explicitPD400Hz. Not a contact-solver-only intervention; no target filtering.
interpretation: The finer timestep reduces shared-band body angular jitter by about19% while retaining nominal XY tracking, but force-bearing two-wheel support is not improved and measured common-band normal-force fluctuations remain large. Do not adopt this as a stable-contact fix or claim numerical convergence/root-cause identification from one refinement.
support_definition: Each wheel requires recorded ground point count>0 AND upward Fz>5N. The fractions are descriptive native sample fractions, not geometric-flight or statistical success rates.
comparison_limitations: Native sampling rates and physical integration differ; native adjacent force/torque differences cannot be ranked as equal-bandwidth rates.
The plotted common10<f<100Hz band avoids comparing200Hz and400Hz signals over unequal Nyquist bands.
Only one fixed checkpoint/seed/episode per setting; no new training or MuJoCo transfer test.
Absolute height and airborne conditions were not added as failure gates; speed and intended nonzero beta targets were preserved.
